Rank_explanation: Ranking logic: (1) All PLS models are ranked above non-PLS models; (2) among non-PLS models, if R2, RMSE and RMSEP are equal, WLS models are preferred over OLS_weighted, which are preferred over OLS; (3) otherwise, within each group, models are ordered by higher R2, lower RMSE, lower RMSEP, then lower AIC/BIC where available.
R2_explanation: R2 is the fraction of variance in the ICP data explained by the model (1 − SS_res / SS_tot); higher is better.
RMSE_explanation: RMSE is the root mean squared error of calibration; lower values indicate better fit on the observed data.
RMSEP_explanation: RMSEP is RMSE estimated by cross-validation (10-fold here when available); lower values indicate better predictive performance.
AIC_BIC_explanation: AIC and BIC penalise model complexity; lower values indicate a better balance between fit and complexity. NA means these criteria are not available for that model type.
